title: Midnight Flow 16x
description: A clean, dark-themed Vanilla+ PvP resource pack
body:
Key Features:

PvP Optimized Gear: Enjoy shorter swords (with a smaller profile in hand), smaller shields, and a reduced fire overlay for maximum visibility during intense fights.

Shield Mechanics: Includes a custom "disabled" state for your shield that turns bright red when broken, giving you an instant visual alert in combat.

Improved Particles: Custom critical hit particles designed for high visibility, helping you track your combat performance and timing with ease.

Custom Essentials: Includes unique designs for Ender Pearls, Elytra, and the Mace, making your endgame gear look sharper than ever.

Refined Environment: Custom-textured Ores, Logs, and Planks that provide a cohesive and pleasant look without sacrificing performance.

Advanced Visuals: Custom potion effect icons that clearly display your status in the HUD, along with a sleek, minimalist style for all potions.

Immersive Soundscape: Featuring custom sounds for the Totem of Undying pop, item pickup effects, and XP orbs, anvildrop and place, adding a unique feel to every action.

16x Resolution: Lightweight and high-performance, ensuring smooth gameplay on any setup.
